automatic.description: Portcove checks when it opens and every few hours, then tells you when an update is ready. It never installs an update until you choose Download and restart.
automatic.label: Check for updates automatically

available.restartDisclosure: Portcove closes to install the update, then opens again. It won’t install while games are running or an install, backup or other library task is still in progress.
available.title: Portcove {{version}} is available

channel.description_beta: Beta gets releases after they’ve been tried on Preview. Recommended for most players.
channel.description_preview: Preview gets new versions first, before Beta. Expect more problems.
channel.heading: Update channel

failure.checkFailed: Portcove couldn’t check for updates. Check your internet connection, then try again.
failure.downloadFailed: Portcove couldn’t download a verified copy of the update. Check your internet connection, then try again.
failure.inProgress: Portcove is already checking for or installing an update. Wait for it to finish.
failure.installFailed: Portcove couldn’t install the update. Your current version is unchanged. Try again, or download the latest version from the Portcove website.
failure.libraryBusy: Portcove is still working on your library, so the update wasn’t installed. Wait for installs, backups and running games to finish, then try again.
failure.libraryInUse: Another Portcove window, the Portcove command line or a running game is using your library, so the update wasn’t installed. Close it, then try again.
failure.libraryNeedsRecovery: Your library needs to finish an upgrade or recovery first, so the update wasn’t installed. Reopen Portcove and let it finish, then try again.
failure.libraryRelocated: Your library has moved, so the update wasn’t installed. Open the library at its new location, then try again.
failure.packageManaged: This copy of Portcove was installed by your package manager. Update it through your package manager instead.
failure.saveFailed: Portcove couldn’t save your update settings. Try again.
failure.stale: This update is no longer available. Check for updates, then try again.
failure.unavailable: Updates aren’t available in this Portcove build. Download the latest version from the Portcove website.

notice.body: See what’s new in Settings, then download and restart when you’re ready.
notice.title: Portcove {{version}} is available

progress.installing: Installing the update. Portcove will restart…

status.current: Portcove is up to date. Last checked {{checked}}.
status.notChecked: Portcove hasn’t checked for updates yet.
status.title: Status
